title: Cloud Security: outage credit
content:
Cloud Security outage credit is governed by these handling clauses.

## Filing, assessment and financial posting

For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing term in calendar days after the official incident closes.

For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its filing time; the request is recorded immediately.

Later review and credit use that recorded filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review.

Starting from the official incident closure time, add the specified outage claim filing term as UTC calendar dates, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods.

Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit.

The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside excluded incident causes.

Availability at or above monthly availability target percentage gives no credit.

Below the target choose the first descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percentage.

Multiply the original source charge net amount by that fraction; subtract the prior pretax service credits component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

Apply the original tax component proportionately.

A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists.

This service-credit branch applies only to source subtype service credit; the invoice correction basis applies only to source subtype correction.

Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write.

A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered.

A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

Prior service credits are measured from posted credits through the frozen handling time for the exact original source charge.

Their service-credit component is the absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings, excluding unrelated source charges.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable request action, authoritative system records must establish: For a service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing term in calendar days after the official incident closes. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference.

### Authoritative eligibility 2

Before the applicable credit action, authoritative system records must establish: For a service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. The evidence is bound to the same original source event reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Can the request and incident alone authorize a credit?**

A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Claim boundary cases

Hypothetical cases: a claim filed exactly at the calculated deadline passes the filing-time gate. A claim filed just after it is rejected without a credit. Review after the deadline does not invalidate a claim filed on time. Passing the filing-time gate alone does not authorize a financial posting.
